info.title: PHANTOM API
info.description: Incident intelligence and response coordination API. AI output is advisory; operational decisions are made by authorised users.

post.summary: Queues a new attempt when the latest one failed (Requirement 6.5).

get.summary: The signed-in responder's assignments, active first.
Staff, or the assigned responder; anyone else gets 404.

post.summary: Reports the responder EnRoute or OnScene.
Completes the assignment with resolution notes. Only a coordinator resolves the incident.

get.summary: The incident's full history: reports, AI analyses, decisions, assignments and updates (15.4, 15.5).
Search by actor, entity, action and date range (15.6).

post.summary: Signs in. The refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie and never returned in the body.
Rotates the refresh cookie and returns a new access token.
Revokes the session's refresh-token family and clears the cookie.

get.summary: Headline counts: total, active, high priority, awaiting review, unassigned, unacknowledged, available responders (12.1).
The most recent incident activity from the audit log, newest first (12.3).
The latest reading with its source and retrieval time, or why there is none.

post.summary: Retrieve again now. Readings are cached per area for a short period, so this may return the cached one.

get.summary: Incidents with coordinates for the operations map, plus a count of those that cannot be plotted.

patch.summary: Edits the working title, description and category. The original public reports are never changed.

post.summary: Verifies the incident. An approved severity is required and is recorded as the coordinator's decision.

put.summary: Changes the approved severity of a verified incident. AI recommendations never use this path.
Confirms or corrects the location. This is the only way a location becomes verified.

post.summary: Submits a public incident report and returns its reference.
post.description:
Send an `Idempotency-Key` (UUID) header; repeating it within 24 hours returns the original
reference instead of creating a second report.

requestBody.description: Up to 5 images (JPEG, PNG, WebP) and 1 audio recording (WebM, OGG, MP3, WAV, M4A), 10 MB each.

get.summary: Returns the coarse public status of a submitted report.

post.summary: Links another incident (by number) as Related without closing either.

put.summary: Confirm a duplicate (requires the primary), mark related, or mark unrelated (never re-suggested).
The signed-in responder sets their own availability (Available or Unavailable).

ActivityEvent.description: A recent change to any incident, worded as on the incident timeline (Requirement 12.3).

AnalysisResponse.description: One AI analysis attempt as shown to staff. `Result` is a recommendation, never an approved value.

AssignedIncident.description: The incident fields a responder needs. Reporter contact details stay with staff.

AssignmentAction.description: What the caller may do next with an assignment.

AssignResponderRequest.description: `OverrideReason` is required when the responder is inactive, unavailable or already assigned (11.2).

AuditEntryResponse.description: An audit record as stored. JSON values are passed through unchanged for inspection.

CorrelationSignals.description: Signal breakdown stored with a suggestion and shown to coordinators.

DashboardSummary.description:
The command dashboard's headline numbers (Requirement 12.1). Every value is counted from the database
when requested (12.2); nothing is cached or stored.

EnvironmentResponse.description:
Weather context for an incident. `Snapshot` is the latest successful reading (which may be for earlier
coordinates when `IsForCurrentLocation` is false). Weather alerts are not offered by the provider.

IncidentAction.description: Coordinator operations that may be offered on an incident, given its status and the caller's role.

IncidentMapResponse.description:
`WithoutCoordinates` counts matching incidents that cannot be plotted, so the map never implies
        it shows everything. `Truncated` is true when more than int IncidentMapResponse.MaxItems matched.

IncidentReportResponse.description: An original public submission. Immutable; contact details are visible to staff only.

Indication.description: How strongly the report indicates something. Deliberately has no "confirmed" value: only people confirm.

IntelligenceResultV1.description: Schema `phantom.intel.v1` (Requirement 6.2). A recommendation for a coordinator, never a decision.

MapIncident.description: One plotted incident. Unverified locations are labelled as such wherever they appear (8.8).

NotificationType.description: What happened (Requirement 14.1). Values are persisted; never rename.

PublicReportStatus.description: The only states a public reporter can see (Requirement 4.10).

PublicStatusResponse.description: Coarse status returned to anonymous callers — no internal data.

RelationDecisionRequest.description: `PrimaryIncidentId` is required to confirm a duplicate: it stays open and receives the reports.

RelationResponse.description: A relation seen from one incident. `Other` is the incident on the far side of the pair.

ResponderFacets.description: Values for the team and skill filters.

SetAvailabilityRequest.description: Only Available or Unavailable; Assigned is derived from an active assignment.

SubmitReportResponse.description: Returned to the public caller on successful submission.

TimelineEvent.description:
One entry in an incident's history (Requirement 15.4). `IsAi` marks AI output so it is never
mistaken for a human decision; `ActorType` says whether a person, the system or the public acted.

VerifyIncidentRequest.description: An omitted severity is a validation error, never a silent default.

VerifyLocationRequest.description: A coordinator confirms or corrects the location; the result is the only verified kind (Requirement 8.5).

VersionedRequest.description: Every write carries the `Version` the client last read; a stale version is a conflict.

WeatherFailureReason.description: Why a weather retrieval failed (Requirement 9.5). Values are persisted; never rename.

WeatherReading.description: Current conditions (Requirement 9.1). Null where the provider did not report a value.
